pr.title: B02 Board movement odds engine
pr.body:
Untyped board input such as `next: 'AB'` previously became two branches, and missing/null adjacency silently became a dead end. B02 now requires an adjacency array containing string IDs and rejects malformed input with `TypeError` through both public odds APIs.

This checkpoint adds 20 rejection checks and a named fixture confirming that the target policy uses directed edge-hop distance through pass-through nodes. Valid dead ends, cycles, self-loops, and unreachable targets retain their documented behavior.

The full local `npm test` passed with Node 24.19.0 and locked TypeScript 5.8.3, using seeds 1, 2, and 3:

- 2,000 random DAGs and 500 cyclic graphs per seed, both policies, every start, faces 0–10, exact mixtures, and literal finite-path comparisons.
- 150,000,000 complete seeded simulated rolls; every required four-sigma gate passed.
- 25 isolated mutants per seed compiled strictly and failed runtime assertions: 75/75 kills.
- 25 named graphs, 350 differential fixture cases, 36 malformed-input checks, and 1,000 rational pairs per seed.
- Strict compilation and checksum verification completed for every seed.

The integrated blind reference is unchanged and matches its pre-exchange seal (`fb3358b51f3c8d6f00ca649da54d283129613cd0229ac33e626519f7daf22e5f`). A separate review confirmed the new rejection checks and policy outputs; additional valid-input review found no further odds defect. Exact commands, source hashes, per-seed counters, simulation bins, and mutation evidence are in `VERIFY.md` and `evidence/cloud-*`.

**[Observed successful final-head CI](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37644498365)** completed successfully at `4ee574ba80aba226e43ea4cea7bd7ceb0f69513e`, with fresh locked installation and the same full suite. Official run metadata confirmed `completed/success` for that exact SHA. The KEEP GOING pass strengthened the weakest malformed-input boundary and reran every required check; the subsequent review found no additional substantive defect.

Implements the original B16 prompt with an actual feasible twelve-color palette, exact CSS sRGB, four16-bit PNG swatches, complete unrounded pair/contrast tables, strict pure TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, and an independently authored sealed reference.

Final full suite passed on pinned Node22.16.0/TypeScript5.9.3 under all3seeds:120,120 independent math views; Sharma34 to4decimals;30,000 independent seeded RNG transitions/replays; all264 actual pair rows and36 actual contrasts perseed;8,847,360 independently reconstructed PNG channels;792 decoded PNG pair gates;25 separately compiled mutations and75 behavioral kills. All17 source/config fingerprints are current and all60 SHA256 checks pass.

First-eight normal minimum20.098712848158538; all12 minima normal16.40907103297625, protan12.099351808360753, deutan12.099695429109461, tritan12.34720618476687. Text/dark/light contrast minima5.446343441951846/3.000296605104743/3.000190395492848. Original gates unchanged.

Use canonical16-bit channel fractions or exact CSS `color(srgb …)`; hex fields are labeled8-bit approximations. Normal PNG fill exactly equals canonical palette; decoded simulated fills also pass original pair gates. Natural interpretation: first8normal>=20; all12normal+all3simulations>=12. Stronger first8/allview>=20 is an explicit optional diagnostic and does not pass.

Separate seals/initial source snapshots, direct Sharma/Machado citations, real3-seed search/refinement logs, actual SLSQP run and600-condition independent feasible-candidate check are included. VERIFY lists case counts/commands and UNVERIFIED device perception, cross-runtime bitwise generation, and approximatehex conformance.

Final head `7bc5e08cda41000a872430333bdf778c71aeb8e8`. **Hosted CI passed at this exact head:** https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37643434658 . Inspected the complete log, all3seeds and all25mutation entries, successful artifact upload, and every job step. PR-merge checkout explicitly includes this final head. The earlier source-evidence run37643082079 also passed. Only B16 job/workflow changed; no main push/merge.

pr.title: B17 40 original synthesized sound effects
pr.body:
Delivers forty original UI/game effects synthesized entirely from oscillators, shaped noise and envelopes, with mono 48 kHz PCM16 WAVs, forty spectrogram PNGs, complete sound recipes, a listening gallery, and reproducible generation.

The strict TypeScript production functions have zero runtime dependencies and preserve caller inputs. A blind independent author implemented synthesis, WAV encoding/decoding and the BS.1770-4 meter; the original sealed source and documented amendments are preserved. Every delivered WAV matches the entire independent synthesis → DC correction → 5 ms fade → loudness mastering → PCM pipeline byte for byte.

Verified under seeds 1, 2 and 3: 120 audio cases, 30 rebuilt mono adaptations of EBU Tech 3341 cases 1–5 and 15–19, 120 external FFmpeg measurements, deterministic WAV/PNG regeneration, FFT versus direct DFT with unchanged inputs, and all 25 independently compiled source mutations caught under each seed (75/75 real assertion failures). All audio is within −16 ±0.5 LUFS, ≤−1.5 dBTP and |DC|<0.001. The rebuilt standards subset is documented and does not claim full EBU Mode certification.

Final exact-head CI is green: https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37636665271
Commit: `14a665830a803b32c63cbb709af493857c4d25f5`. All workflow steps and the full log were inspected. Committed verification evidence matches all 15 source/configuration fingerprints; the full CI suite checks integrity and complete coverage of all 111 deliverable hashes. `README.md`, `VERIFY.md`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, `reports/`, `ORACLE.md`, `ORACLE_AMENDMENTS.md`, `LOOP.md` and `NEXT.md` contain reproduction steps, measured results, isolation evidence and handoff details. Run `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm test` with Node 22.16.0 and FFmpeg.

pr.title: B18 Tiny spring + easing library
pr.body:
The complete B18 suites now compare every required input with sealed references authored independently before production access. The runtime exports closed-form spring position and velocity, a conservative settling estimate, CSS cubic-Bezier easing with endpoint extrapolation, and four named CSS easings. It remains pure TypeScript with zero runtime dependencies.

The delivery adds authoring provenance and sealed sources, publishes the full fresh three-seed results, and updates verification notes and hashes. Existing reference algorithms remain supplemental checks. Scope is `jobs/B18-motion-ts/**` and the required `.github/workflows/B18.yml`.

## Verification

The full local `npm test` passed all 20 suites for seeds 1, 2 and 3. Clean local `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund` succeeded.

| Gate | Measured result |
| --- | --- |
| Spring vs independently authored RK4 | 10,000 trajectories per seed; all 151,939,668 states and both components checked at dt=1e-4 |
| Maximum RK4 error | Position 2.4221158412274235e-10; velocity 7.264086576697082e-8; both <1e-6 |
| Independent analytic spring | 10,000 endpoints per seed; maximum error 5.644373857194296e-13 |
| Bezier vs independently authored 113-bit oracle | 1,000,000 points per seed; maximum error 3.637978807091713e-12 <1e-7 |
| Four named easings | 40,004 points per seed; maximum error 4.440892098500626e-16 |
| Settling | 10,000 supplemental envelope inversions and 640,000 production tail samples per seed; another 640,000 tail samples for the independently derived bound |
| Deliberate bugs | All 25 isolated mutants compiled and were caught per seed: 75 assertion kills, zero survivors, zero compiler-error kills |
| Gzip, level 9 including wrapper | TypeScript 842 bytes; emitted JavaScript 946 bytes; both <=1,200 |
| Finite-output safety | 466,524 boundary/fuzz cases per seed |
| Integrity | All 26 delivered-file SHA256 entries verified, including the workflow |

`VERIFY.md` lists every suite, count, seed, exact command and mutation. `results/seed{1,2,3}.json` preserves measured maxima, worst inputs, reference stream hashes and mutation failure records. `tests/blind/AUTHORING.md` and `SEALED-SHA256SUMS.txt` document independent source authoring and hashes reported before integration. Every original million-point and every-frame comparison remains in the full suite.

## Final-head hosted CI

Final commit: `c0570a857ae7e76573c94b3c70ac2bb57065cba5`.

**[B18 motion verification — successful final-head run](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37635529608)** completed successfully on **2026-10-07 at 14:20:31 UTC**, against the exact final commit above. Clean `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, the full `npm test` for seeds 1/2/3 including every mutant, and upload of fresh JSON all passed. [Job details](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37635529608/job/112840621657).

## Rerun and limits

```sh
cd jobs/B18-motion-ts
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
```

Verification requires Linux, Node 22+ and GNU g++ with libquadmath. Accuracy applies to the explicit tested domains in README; finite saturation does not establish accurate physics for arbitrary extreme coefficients or phases. CSS semantics were checked against W3C and numerical references; live browser differential sampling has not been run. Invalid x controls use the documented identity fallback. Settling estimates are conservative bounds; Number.MAX_VALUE denotes no supplied representable finite bound.
